name: חַשּׁוּב
summary: Men of the return: a Merarite Levite, father of Shemaiah, in the line of Hashabiah (1Ch 9:14; Neh 11:15); Hasshub son of Pahath-moab, who repaired a second section and the tower of the ovens (Neh 3:11); another Hasshub who repaired opposite his own house (Neh 3:23); and one of the chiefs who sealed the covenant (Neh 10:24). The name is formed from חָשַׁב in the pattern qattūl, which names a quality: “thoughtful”, or with a passive sense “esteemed, of account”, as the root's passive “reckoned” (Isa 53:3; Mal 3:16 for the active “esteem”). Scripture does not explain it.

evidence.note: “Malchijah son of Harim and חַשּׁוּב son of Pahath-moab repaired a second section.”
“Shemaiah son of חַשּׁוּב, son of Azrikam, son of Hashabiah.”
“Those who esteem (חֹשְׁבֵי) his name”: the root's sense of regard.

note: Takes h.gr.ad (5 tokens). TIPNR's Hasshub@Neh.10.23 is Neh 10:24 in the Hebrew. The two readings (active “thoughtful”, passive “esteemed”) are readings of the form only.
